brief:
Slug: s1-press-states
Type and size preset: State machine, doc-inline.
Layout: Left to right, Idle, Pulling, then Tab open, /wt sent. Route the return to Idle below the states and the Pulling self-loop above it.
Content: States `Idle`, `Pulling`, `Tab open, /wt sent`. Edges: Idle → Pulling labelled `press`; Pulling → Tab open, /wt sent labelled `pull ends`; Tab open, /wt sent → Idle labelled `done`. Pulling has a self-loop labelled `press again`, with note `? (Q9)`. Focal elements: Pulling and its self-loop.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Add no node, edge, or label beyond this brief.

Slug: s2-endstate-options
Type and size preset: State machine, doc-inline.
Layout: Three states in one left-to-right row, with each stop marker directly below its state.
Content: States `Committed`, `Merge-ready`, `Shipped`. Edges: Committed → Merge-ready labelled `push, open PR, drive CI`; Merge-ready → Shipped labelled `merge into main`. Stop markers: `A stops here` under Committed, `B stops here` under Merge-ready, `C stops here` under Shipped. Focal element: Committed.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Add no node, edge, or label beyond this brief.

Slug: s3-image-layers
Type and size preset: Layer stack, doc-inline.
Layout: Three layers stacked bottom to top, A below B below C. Put the upward annotation arrow beside the stack.
Groups: Bottom layer A contains `A. Ảnh xem nhanh`; middle layer B contains `B. Render Cycles`; top layer C contains `C. Ảnh AI theo style`.
Content: Bottom `A. Ảnh xem nhanh`, sublabel `phối cảnh + axonometric từng tầng · không vật liệu`. Middle `B. Render Cycles`, sublabel `thêm vật liệu, ánh sáng, góc nội thất · viết bước render mới`. Top `C. Ảnh AI theo style`, sublabel `thêm style · tốn credit, gen lại nhiều vòng`. Side annotation arrow points up, labelled `mỗi lớp cần lớp dưới`. Focal element: layer A, tagged `đề xuất`.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep the Vietnamese labels and diacritics exactly. Add no content beyond this brief.

Slug: n1-two-contracts
Type and size preset: Tree, doc-inline.
Layout: Top to bottom. Center the common root above two parallel branches, A2b on the left and A3 on the right. Each branch has its own build and output below its contract.
Content: Root `nguồn chung: vỏ nhà, thang, sân, khu đất` has children `contract A2b` and `contract A3`, each with sublabel `đồ đạc, cửa ban công, cửa sổ 10 căn`. Each contract → its own `build` → its own `6 tờ + IFC + ảnh xem nhanh`. All edges are unlabelled. Focal elements: the two contract nodes.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep the Vietnamese labels and diacritics exactly. Schematic, not to scale. Add no content beyond this brief.

Slug: n2-status-today
Type and size preset: State machine, doc-inline.
Layout: Left to right from working. Put input above idle and done, and error below working's outgoing paths. Keep the idle → done → idle cycle together.
Content: States `working`, `input`, `idle`, `done`, `error`. Initial state working. Transitions: working → input labelled `asks you`; working → idle labelled `turn ends`; idle → done labelled `terminal alert, unseen`; done → idle labelled `you see the pane`; working → error labelled `omp error banner only`. Focal element: the working → error edge.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Show one agent pane's Go to picker states. Add no content beyond this brief.

Slug: n3-forensics-lanes
Type and size preset: Swimlane, doc-inline.
Layout: Six chronological columns from left to right for steps 2 through 7. Two horizontal lanes, Live above Analysis. Arrows zigzag between the lanes in step order.
Groups: `Live: runs the app` contains `2. Launch and capture`, `4. Probe mechanism`, `6. Paired capture, cleanup`. `Analysis: no app` contains `3. Parse to sqlite`, `5. Attribute to source`, `7. Report diagnosis`.
Content: Nodes are the six steps listed in Groups. Unlabelled arrows connect 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7. Focal element: `4. Probe mechanism`.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Add no node, edge, or label beyond this brief.

Slug: n4-notes-today
Type and size preset: Flowchart, doc-inline.
Layout: Left to right. Place add and list as separate inputs on the left, notes.txt in the center, and print the whole file on the right. Put join words with spaces between add and notes.txt.
Content: Five nodes: `add <words…>` as a command; `join words with spaces`; `notes.txt` with sublabel `one line per note, no fields`; `list` as a command; `print the whole file`. Edges: add → join words with spaces, unlabelled; join words with spaces → notes.txt labelled `append line`; list → notes.txt labelled `read`; notes.txt → print the whole file, unlabelled. Focal element: notes.txt.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep exactly these five nodes. Add no other content.

Slug: n5-finding-context
Type and size preset: Flowchart, doc-inline.
Layout: Top to bottom from the shared start and decision. Put the Scan Finding branch in a left column and the SBOM Finding branch in a right column, with their endpoints aligned at the bottom.
Groups: Left branch contains `FindingFilterRequestDTO has gitRef + gitRefType`, `Browser: Scan Findings tab is ref-scoped`, `CLI wrapper + PAT annotation only`. Right branch contains `FindingSbomFilterRequestDTO has no git ref`, `Browser: no ref scoping`, `New backend filter + new operation`.
Content: Start `Finding read with --git-ref` → decision `Which finding kind?`. Edge labelled `Scan Finding` enters the left branch, whose three nodes connect in the listed order. Edge labelled `SBOM Finding` enters the right branch, whose three nodes connect in the listed order. Other edges are unlabelled. Focal elements: the two endpoints, left neutral or success tone, right warning tone.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep every given label exactly. Add no other content.

Slug: c1-reopen-options
Type and size preset: Flowchart, doc-inline.
Layout: Three parallel horizontal rows, A above B above C. Each row flows left to right through four aligned columns.
Groups: Row A `Reopen, then Closes` contains `reopen 4 issues`, `PR body: Closes #142..#145`, `merge`, `issues close`. Row B `Refs only` contains `issues stay closed`, `PR body: Refs #142`, `merge`, `no issue change`. Row C `Closes on closed issues` contains `issues stay closed`, `PR body: Closes #142..#145`, `merge`, `no effect`. Each repeated label is a separate node in its row.
Content: Within each row, unlabelled edges connect the four nodes in the listed order. There are no edges between rows. Focal element: `issues close` in row A.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep all 12 nodes and their exact labels. Add no other content.

Slug: c2-push-order
Type and size preset: Timeline, doc-inline.
Layout: Three horizontal lanes stacked A, B, C from top to bottom. Time runs left to right. Align events that share their order position.
Groups: Lane `A. Đưa lên ngay` contains `Push main = 35af8a8`, `Sửa nguồn cặp (#44)`, `#45`, `Đóng #39`. Lane `B. Chờ xong` contains `Sửa nguồn cặp (#44)`, `#45`, `Push main`, `Đóng #39`. Lane `C. PR` contains `Push nhánh + mở PR`, `Sửa nguồn cặp (#44)`, `#45`, `Merge PR`, `Đóng #39`.
Content: Each lane connects its events in the listed order. Mark the point after which work is safe on the remote with a small tag `an toàn trên remote`, after the first event in A, after Push main in B, and after Push nhánh + mở PR in C. Focal element: lane A, marked as recommended.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep the Vietnamese labels and diacritics exactly. Add no events beyond this brief.

Slug: c3-close-options
Type and size preset: Sequence, doc-wide.
Layout: Two side-by-side panels, A on the left and B on the right. Each panel has lifelines You, Agent, Caller from left to right. Time runs top to bottom independently in each panel.
Groups: Panel A `Wait for your prompt` has lifelines You, Agent, Caller. Panel B `Proceed in the same turn` has its own lifelines You, Agent, Caller. These are six lifelines across two panels, not six distinct roles.
Content: Title `Who acts first after the summary`. A messages in order: Agent → You `closing summary, turn ends`; You → Agent `next prompt (go on, or pushback)`; Agent → Caller `act`; Caller → Caller `tracker write`. B messages in order: Agent → You `closing summary`; Agent → Caller `act at once`; Caller → Caller `tracker write`; You → Agent `pushback, if any, after the write`. Focal elements: A's second message, the prompt before the write, and B's fourth message, pushback after the write.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Preserve both panels and every message. Add no participants or content.

Slug: c4-command-paths
Type and size preset: Tree, doc-wide.
Layout: Two trees side by side, A on the left and B on the right. Each tree grows top to bottom. Preserve the listed sibling order.
Groups: Left tree `A. Under product` contains atlas, product, list, show, create, git-config show, scanner-template list. Right tree `B. New nouns` contains atlas, product, its list, show, create children, git-config and its show child, scanner-template and its list child. Repeated labels are separate nodes.
Content: Left edges: `atlas` → `product`; product → `list`, `show`, `create`, `git-config show`, `scanner-template list`. Mark the last two leaves new. Right edges: `atlas` → `product`, `git-config`, `scanner-template`; product → `list`, `show`, `create`; git-config → `show`; scanner-template → `list`. Mark the git-config show and scanner-template list paths new. Focal elements: the new paths in the two trees. All edges are unlabelled.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep both trees and all 16 nodes. Add no other content.

Slug: c5-who-moves-pr
Type and size preset: Swimlane, doc-inline.
Layout: Two option rows, A above B, with time running left to right. Within each option, assign the steps to ship or Conflict owner lanes as stated. Preserve the handoffs across lanes in A.
Groups: Row `A. Conflict owner` has ship steps `report move`, `fresh verdict`, and Conflict owner steps `retarget-pr to default`, `merge default branch`, `fast-forward push`. Row `B. ship itself` has only the ship lane with `retarget-pr to default`, `update-branch`, `fresh verdict`.
Content: Title `Who moves PR 3`. A edges: ship report move → Conflict owner retarget-pr to default → merge default branch → fast-forward push → ship fresh verdict. B edges: retarget-pr to default → update-branch → fresh verdict. All edges are unlabelled. B callout `breaks the frontier rule`. Focal element: row A, marked recommended.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Add no node, edge, or label beyond this brief.

Slug: c6-design-orders
Type and size preset: Timeline, doc-inline.
Layout: Two horizontal lanes, A above B, on a shared left-to-right time axis. In A, all six blocks are sequential. In B, stack the three design blocks at the same time position, then place the three grill blocks in sequence.
Groups: Lane A `One at a time` contains C1 designs, C1 grill, C2 designs, C2 grill, C3 designs, C3 grill. Lane B `All at once` contains a parallel design group of C1 designs, C2 designs, C3 designs, followed by C1 grill, C2 grill, C3 grill.
Content: Title `Three picked candidates, two orders`. Use the exact block labels from Groups. Put tag `recommended` on A. Under A's C2 designs put note `brief uses C1 decisions`. Under B's parallel design group put sublabel `9–12 explorers`. Axis label `time`. Connect sequential blocks in their stated order, with the parallel group before B's C1 grill. Focal element: lane A.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Draw the title inside the exported SVG. Add no other content.

Slug: c7-tag-storage
Type and size preset: Flowchart, doc-inline.
Layout: Three horizontal rows, A above B above C. Each row flows left to right through three aligned columns titled `command`, `line in notes.txt`, `how list finds tags`.
Groups: Row `A. Inline #tags` contains `add 'call bank #money'`, `call bank #money`, `reads #words in the text`. Row `B. --tag flags` contains `add call bank --tag money`, `call bank ⇥ money`, `reads the tag field`. Row `C. Both` contains `add 'call bank #money' --tag todo`, `call bank #money ⇥ todo`, `reads #words and the tag field`.
Content: Unlabelled edges connect the three nodes within each row in the listed order. No edges between rows. Focal element: row A, marked recommended.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Preserve the exact command and stored-line labels. Add no other content.

Slug: c8-owned-rule
Type and size preset: Architecture delta, doc-inline.
Layout: Before on the left and After on the right. In each panel, place the first-push path above the Conflict owner node. Keep corresponding nodes aligned between panels.
Groups: Before contains `step 0b first push`, `absent-ref lease + porcelain '*' check`, `Owned flag`, `rewrite rule`, `Conflict owner rebase`. After contains `step 0b first push`, `Owned flag`, `rewrite rule`, `Conflict owner merge`.
Content: Title `What the Owned rule guards`. Before edges: step 0b first push → absent-ref lease + porcelain '*' check → Owned flag → rewrite rule; Conflict owner rebase → rewrite rule. Before rewrite rule has sublabel `lease on last pushed SHA`. After edges: step 0b first push → Owned flag → rewrite rule. After Conflict owner merge has no edge to rewrite rule. Mark After rewrite rule `no caller` with changed or removed styling. Other edges are unlabelled. Focal element: the missing edge from After Conflict owner merge to rewrite rule.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep the disconnected After node. Add no other content.

Slug: c9-mep-options
Type and size preset: Process, doc-inline.
Layout: Three horizontal step strips, A above B above C, flowing left to right. Align the common steps across strips.
Groups: Strip `A` contains `4 tầng`, `5 3D`, `6 góc + prompt`, `7 ảnh`, `8 điện nước`, `9 gói`. Strip `B` contains `4 tầng + điện nước`, `5 3D`, `6 góc + prompt`, `7 ảnh`, `8 gói`. Strip `C` contains `4 tầng`, `5 3D`, `6 góc + prompt`, `7 ảnh`, `8 gói`.
Content: Within each strip, unlabelled arrows connect its steps in the listed order. C's `8 gói` has sublabel `không điện nước`. Highlight the điện nước steps in A and B. Focal element: strip A, tagged `đề xuất`.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Keep the Vietnamese labels and diacritics exactly. Preserve all 16 step nodes. Add no other content.

Slug: c10-pick-settles
Type and size preset: Flowchart, doc-wide.
Layout: Two side-by-side lanes, A on the left and B on the right, each flowing top to bottom. Keep each lane's decision branches inside that lane.
Groups: Lane `A. A pick settles` contains A1 `Answer comes back`, A2 decision `Any option picked?`, A3 `Settle; notes kept`, A4 decision `Other text names a choice?`, A5 `Settle`, A6 `Reopen`. Lane `B. The agent judges every note` contains B1 `Each note, picked or not`, B2 decision `Asks, rejects, or proposes?`, B3 `Reopen`, B4 `Settle`.
Content: A edges: A1 → A2, unlabelled; A2 → A3 labelled `yes`; A2 → A4 labelled `no`; A4 → A5 labelled `yes`; A4 → A6 labelled `no`. B edges: B1 → B2, unlabelled; B2 → B3 labelled `yes`; B2 → B4 labelled `no`. Focal elements: A2 and A6.
Out dir: {out}
Extra rules: Node identifiers A1 through B4 identify the given nodes, not additional display labels. Add no other content.
